meta.producto: A small yellow and black toy vehicle assembly.
meta.operacion: The left hand typically holds the workpiece in the center while the right hand fetches small parts from the bottom and fits them onto the assembly.
meta.lugar: Supply areas: bottom center and bottom right. Work point: center. Instructions: top center.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the top. Right hand (magenta) appears on the left side of the image; left hand (cyan) appears on the right side.
meta.title_en: LEGO Creator 5761 Mini Digger, full assembly (56 pieces)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B on AMD GPUs (AMD Token Factory, shared endpoint)
